TANDA is a financial technology company, not a bank.

Banking services will be provided by an FDIC-insured partner bank, to be named. TANDA accounts are not yet available, and nothing on this site is an offer to open an account or an offer of credit. Products, features, fees and benefits described are planned, depend on partner-bank approval and regulatory review, and may change.
